Ten packages, all on CRAN, all documented, all actively maintained. Each was
written while teaching at [Rsquared Academy](https://www.rsquaredacademy.com/)
and shared in the hope that others find them useful.

The goal is software which is user friendly, light weight, well tested and well
documented. Major bugs get fixed quickly; feature requests are considered but
not promised.

Full descriptions and vignettes: [pkgs.rsquaredacademy.com](https://pkgs.rsquaredacademy.com/).

### [olsrr](https://olsrr.rsquaredacademy.com)

<p class="lout">Tools for building linear regression models.</p>

<p class="lprereq">Diagnostics, variable selection and influence measures for a fitted <code>lm</code>.</p>


<details>
<summary>What's inside</summary>

- Comprehensive Regression Output
- Variable Selection Procedures
- Heteroskedasticity Tests
- Collinearity Diagnostics
- Model Fit Assessment
- Measures of Influence
- Residual Diagnostics

</details>
:::
:::

::: {.lside}

:::

::: {.lbody}

<span class="ltrack">Flagship</span>

### [blorr](https://blorr.rsquaredacademy.com)

<p class="lout">Tools for building binary logistic regression models.</p>

<p class="lprereq">Model fit, validation and collinearity for a fitted <code>glm</code> with a binary outcome.</p>


<details>
<summary>What's inside</summary>

- Bivariate Analysis
- Model Fit Statistics
- Model Validation
- Variable Selection
- Residual Diagnostics
- Collinearity Diagnostics
- Visualization

</details>
:::
:::

[Docs](https://xplorerr.rsquaredacademy.com){.labtn}

::: {.lbody}

<span class="ltrack">Flagship</span>

### [xplorerr](https://xplorerr.rsquaredacademy.com)

<p class="lout">Tools for interactive data analysis.</p>

<p class="lprereq">Descriptive, inferential and visual analysis behind a Shiny interface. See <a href="../apps/">Apps</a>.</p>

<summary>What's inside</summary>

- Descriptive Statistics
- Inferential Statistics

- RFM Analysis
- Linear Regression
- Logistic Regression

</details>
:::

### [inferr](https://inferr.rsquaredacademy.com)

<p class="lout">Tools for inferential statistics.</p>

<p class="lprereq">Hypothesis tests with plain R syntax — no formulas to memorise.</p>


<details>
<summary>What's inside</summary>

- Binomial Test
- Test of Proportion
- t Test
- Chi Square Test
- Levene's Test
- Test of Variance
- McNemar Test
- Cochran Q Test
- Runs Test

</details>
:::
:::

### [vistributions](https://vistributions.rsquaredacademy.com)

<p class="lout">Tools for visualizing probability distributions.</p>

<details>

- t Distribution
- Includes Shiny App

<span class="ltrack">Flagship</span>

### [rbin](https://rbin.rsquaredacademy.com)

<p class="lout">Tools for binning data.</p>

<p class="lprereq">Turn continuous variables into factors, and generate dummy variables from them.</p>


<details>
<summary>What's inside</summary>

- Manual Binning
- Quantile Binning
- Winsorized Binning
- Equal Length Binning
- Equal Width Binning
- Factor Binning
- Generate Dummy Variables
- Includes RStudio Addins

</details>
:::
:::

<span class="ltrack">Flagship</span>

### [rfm](https://rfm.rsquaredacademy.com)

<p class="lout">Tools for RFM analysis.</p>

<p class="lprereq">Score and segment customers from transaction-level data. See <a href="../apps/">Apps</a>.</p>


<details>
<summary>What's inside</summary>

- Generate RFM Scores
- Handles Transaction / Customer Level Data
- Visualization Tools
- Segment Customers
- Includes Shiny App

</details>
:::
